title: Calibrated Logistic Regression Post-Processing: Target Brier 0.199 (MDPI Jan 2026)

research_basis.source: MDPI Information 2026 (Jan) — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
research_basis.finding: Logistic regression attained Brier 0.199 and log-loss 0.583 — BEST among all tabular baselines tested. XGBoost was Brier 0.202. The key: LR was trained with proper calibration (no overconfidence) while tree models needed post-hoc calibration.

research_basis.source: arXiv 2025 — Forecasting NCAA Basketball with LSTM vs Transformer
research_basis.finding: LSTM trained with Brier loss > LSTM trained with BCE for probability calibration. Transformer + BCE best for AUC. Ensemble of both (Brier-loss + BCE) gives complementary gains.
Stacked ensemble (XGBoost + MLP + KNN + LR) reduces variance, improves calibration vs any single model.
Dual Elo (regular season + playoff track) consistently among top-3 features. S13 already converging on xgboost_brier — adding LR calibration post-processing could push below checkpoint.

problem: Current GA evolves tree models (XGBoost, CatBoost, RF, LightGBM) that produce uncalibrated probabilities. The MDPI 2026 paper shows LR achieves Brier 0.199 vs XGBoost 0.202 on NBA data — the gap comes from LR's natural calibration (linear decision boundary = no overconfidence). Our best current island Brier = 0.22066 (S13). The checkpoint threshold is 0.21837. Adding isotonic or Platt calibration post-processing could push S13 below threshold.

phase_1.name: Isotonic Calibration Post-Processing on S13
phase_1.action: After model.predict_proba(), wrap with sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic'). Use 20% holdout for calibration fitting. This is already stubbed in calibration/isotonic_calibrator.py.
phase_1.risk: LOW — post-processing only, doesn't change model architecture

phase_2.name: LR Meta-Learner over S10-S15 ensemble predictions
phase_2.action: Collect daily predict_proba() from all 6 islands. Train a logistic regression meta-learner on island predictions + 5 key features (elo_diff, rest_advantage, home_flag, spread, form_diff). LR naturally calibrates the ensemble output.
phase_2.risk: MEDIUM — requires 50+ games of calibration data to be robust

phase_3.name: Add h_elo_playoff + a_elo_playoff as Cat50 features
phase_3.action: Add 10 new features to Cat24: playoff_elo_h, playoff_elo_a, playoff_elo_diff, playoff_season_elo_ratio_h, playoff_season_elo_ratio_a, clutch_elo_h (close-game adjusted), momentum_elo_5_h, momentum_elo_5_a, elo_convergence_speed_h, elo_convergence_speed_a. Dual Elo is consistently top-3 feature per MDPI 2026 study.
phase_3.risk: LOW — additive features, GA selects naturally

immediate_action.recommended: Phase 1 (isotonic calibration) on S13 — lowest risk, highest probability of pushing below checkpoint threshold 0.21837
immediate_action.note: If /api/config supports calibration toggle. Else: update hf-space/app.py directly.

cross_project_port.political_alpha: Same isotonic calibration applies to PA-1 (Brier 0.24186). Port Phase 1 to political_engine.py calibration block. Expected: -0.003 to -0.006 on political Brier.
